correctness.rationale: The definitions of inclusion-maximal matching, edge query, shattering, and 48 cube automorphisms are explicit. Both exhaustive implementations check all 4096 edge subsets, derive 17 concepts and all 4096 support traces, and reproduce coefficients 1,12,42,32 with 6 two-edge and 32 three-edge facets. The exact rational rank of the 42-by-32 signed boundary is 25. A specified rank-25 minor has exact determinant +1, proving primitive image and integral torsion-freeness; connectedness gives H1=Z^6, H2=Z^7. All edges occur in five concepts and a shattered triple exists, proving Littlestone=VC=3. Both verification programs and their output records are self-contained and have been replayed. No claim about larger cubes, sphere-wedge homotopy, or external independent validation is made.

value.rationale: A complete and natural symmetric finite shattering classification for maximal matchings of the canonical 3-cube isolates the unique geometric parallel-triple obstruction, identifies all symmetry orbits of maximal supports, and determines two independent nonzero integral homology groups with an explicit primitive lattice certificate. The shattering complex is not the ordinary matching complex, and its topology is not determined by the VC rank. The precise finite result is motivated by maximal-matching incidence learning and the topology of shattering complexes, rather than an arbitrary restriction of parameters.
